sequence: agent managed-preview 7a00003a-… --prompt=<exact contents of SKILL.corrected.md> -o json

limits.http_expected: 5 or 6 (one request per step, plus one token refresh only if the stored token is within 60 s of expiry)
limits.local_version_check: one local `seren --version` before any service call, same 60 s timeout; not a service invocation
limits.enforced_by_the_route: each step at most once and at most 5 service invocations ever for this identity (journaled before sending; a re-invocation only resumes); the 60 s timeout per CLI process (killed and reaped on expiry); no harness retry; the fixed command sequence; binding and pin checks before any call; the prerequisite gate before the preview
limits.operator_requirements_not_enforced_by_co: one command invocation (a second one only resumes and never repeats a step); the 15-minute window; confirming by name only, before the run, that SEREN_API_BASE, SEREN_OAUTH_HOST and SEREN_CLIENT_ID are unset in the executing shell (the pinned CLI reads them; the harness does not clear them)
limits.basis: Pinned v0.10.0 (cli/src/commands/agent.rs): managed_agent_get, cloud_status and managed_agent_preview each call ctx.client() (command_context.rs) and then send exactly one SDK request (seren_agent_get_managed_deployment GET /deployments/{id}/managed; seren_cloud_get_deployment GET /deployments/{id}; seren_agent_preview_managed_deployment_update POST /deployments/{id}/managed/preview). The preview body is built locally from --prompt only; with no --config, --env-file or --agent-config no file is read. Error formatting (anyhow_from_seren_error, format_payment_required_response, cloud_status map_err) reads the existing response and sends nothing. ctx.client() -> auth.rs get_bearer_token -> maybe_refresh_oauth_token: at most one token POST, only when expires_at - 60 s <= now and a refresh token is stored, on a client with redirects disabled; the refreshed session is re-saved under the selected root. The SDK client (sdk/src/lib.rs from_config) uses reqwest 0.13.4's default redirect policy, limited(10), and a 60 s request timeout. reqwest 0.13.4 also wraps every request in its default retry policy (retry.rs: ProtocolNacks, at most 2 extra), but its classifier only matches HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 errors; the pinned Cargo.lock builds reqwest without h2 or h3 (features form, json, rustls, stream, multipart), so that retry never fires. hyper-util 0.1.19 re-dispatches a request only if it was never started on a reused pooled connection, which is not a transmission. Per invocation therefore: at most 1 refresh + 1 request + 10 redirects = 12 HTTP requests; five invocations: at most 60. Redirects of the preview POST (tower-http 0.6.8 follow_redirect): 301/302/303 continue as GET without the body; 307/308 re-send the same POST body, so in the worst case the preview body could be delivered up to 11 times within its one invocation. No redirect has been observed; this is a source-derived ceiling. Wall: 62 s for the version check plus 5 x 62 s (60 s timeout plus about 2 s local overhead) = 372 s.

side_effects.preview: Its server-side effects are uncertain and not assumed absent. Pinned source treats it as a direct POST, not a managed mutation (no request id, no submit_managed_mutation re-send). The post-preview reads record what is observed; a change is reported, not attributed or repaired.
side_effects.cli_local: On every invocation the pinned CLI creates <config_home>/seren and the profile directory if missing and sets them to 0700, and it may refresh and re-save the stored session near expiry. The harness never opens, copies or inspects the session.

excluded: No managed-update, provisioning, Passwords setup or apply, start, stop, Discord request, probe, model session, instruction-update, login, credential repair, permission change or default-directory cleanup. The command has no route to any of them.

evidence.journal: <config state_dir>/preview-diagnostic/seren.lifecycle.preview-diagnostic.2/journal.json (separate from preview diagnostic 1, both instruction-update journals and both prerequisite-read journals)
evidence.kept: binding digests (config, package, instruction files, CLI executable and version) and cli_session; per step: purpose, command name, times, status class and exit code; a fixed failure classification per failed step (cli_errors: category, rule, stage, HTTP status only from the CLI's own format); structural observations of config, secret_keys, guarded and policy fields, bundle, changed_fields and pre/post state
evidence.never_kept: raw responses, values, unlisted key names, labels, condition messages, stderr, secret values, tokens, headers, or any hash of response content

stop_conditions: local pins, CLI checksum or version differ, or the private config lacks explicit config_home and profile: refused before any call
a recorded journal whose inputs (including cli_session) differ, or one with an older binding: refused before any call, journal untouched
a prerequisite read fails, or the reads do not show the recorded deployment, identity, revision 7a00002b, original instruction and stopped/stopped: stop before the preview
after the preview is attempted (answered, failed, timed out or malformed): only the two post-preview reads, then stop
an interruption before the preview: no preview on re-invocation; after the preview: only the post-preview reads not yet started; a started step counts as used
post-preview state differs from the prerequisite state: reported as an observation only; no repair, rollback, start or stop
acceptance: Either result=complete with structural observations of config and secret_keys in the pre-preview read, preview current, preview proposed and post-preview read, plus the post-preview state; or an explicit stopped_before_preview / incomplete result that lists each unavailable observation and its fixed classification.
